skills-first-reminder.ref: scripts/agent-os/skillsFirstReminder.test.mjs runs the configured UserPromptSubmit command verbatim through /bin/sh and asserts exit 0 plus the reminder text. Its BREAKS arm proves the assertion fails for a missing script and for a silent hook. Mutations run on this branch: weaker wording failed on 'the reminder must say when'; exit 2 failed on 'the hook must exit 0'. hookCommand.test.mjs also launches every configured node hook.
